init.title: Tariff
init.description: Either a price sensor, or two fixed prices with an off-peak source (binary sensor or time windows). Leave everything empty to record sessions without cost.

data_description.price_entity: Takes precedence over the fixed prices.
data_description.off_peak_windows: For example 22:00-06:00, several separated by commas. Ignored when an off-peak binary sensor is set.

error.invalid_windows: Use HH:MM-HH:MM, several separated by commas (e.g. 22:00-06:00, 12:00-14:00).

data_description.power_entity: Power sensor in W or kW.
data_description.energy_entity: Session or total energy counter of the charger; when set, session energy comes from it.
data_description.plug_entity: Binary sensor, or a sensor with the states below.
data_description.plugged_states: Leave empty for a binary sensor (on = plugged in).
data_description.power_threshold_w: Charging when the power is above this value.
data_description.gap_hours: Without a plug entity, a session ends after this long without charging.

data_description.soc_entity: Sensor in %. Without it, sessions have no start and end level.
data_description.target_fixed: Used when no target entity is set.
